name: WPC Shared Stock – Attribute Stock & Group Stock for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC Shared Stock is the smart solution for WooCommerce stores that share a single physical inventory source across multiple products or product variations. If you sell the same physical item under different listings or attributes, this plugin will ensure the stock is synchronized seamlessly across all of them in real-time.

Say goodbye to manually updating stock levels on multiple product pages and risking overselling!

Key Features

  • Shared Stock Groups: Create centralized inventory groups to track unified stock.
  • Product & Variation Mapping: Link multiple products or specific variations to a single stock source.
  • Global Attribute Mapping (Premium): Map specific terms seamlessly to stock groups without duplicating products.
  • Ratio Multipliers: Dedicate different consumption numbers (e.g. 1 pack consumes 6 single items).
  • Detailed Audit Logging: Keep track of every backend and frontend stock modification via a modern UI.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpc-shared-stock/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Shared Stock dashboard menu to start grouping your inventory.
sections.faq:
Does it work with variations?

Yes, it fully supports individual variations, meaning different variations inside a variable product can map to different shared stock groups.

What happens when an order is placed?

Once a frontend order is placed, the shared stock group reduces stock according to the multiplier, and all attached products update their availability immediately.
